messages:
maria: heads up — merged PR to gpupool module changed the `instance_profile` input from a string to an object. This will break repos passing a bare string. cc @alex @kevin
alex: when did that merge land?
maria: ~1h ago. I approved to add spot/ondemand labels. PR: https://git.internal/pr/4732
kevin: which repos reference gpupool? if they are pinned they won't auto-upgrade right?
maria: infra-core, batch-jobs, training-farm, dev-reserved, ci-gpu. Many use `~> 2.3`. Pinned ones safe for now.
sam: we should add a shim to accept both shapes. quick fallback: coerce string -> {profile_name=string} in locals.
maria: proposed shim in PR 4740. minimal logic using `can()` and `try()` so it's a patch-level change.
alex: also add a TF schema check step in gitops CI to catch input type regressions pre-merge. I can add job today.
kevin: rollout idea: cut 2.4 with shim, run canary by updating dev-reserved to 2.4 and run terragrunt plan/apply in staging. watch SLOs.
maria: timeline: shim PR in ~2h, cut tag after CI, alex adds tf-schema-check, canary apply 09:30 UTC tomorrow.
deploy-bot: ci-gitops: queued job `tf-schema-check` for repo infra-core. build 5823 expected in ~8m.
sam: another subtle one: `kms_key` usages — some repos use `kms_key = module.gpupool.kms_id` which will need to become `kms = { id = ... }` if we standardize. I'll run grep and add upgrade note.
alex: I'll prototype a codemod (jq/sed) to rewrite `instance_profile = "name"` -> `instance_profile = { profile_name = "name" }` and open PRs for easy upgrades.
kevin: if any apply shows unexpected diffs to IAM or VPC attachments, pause the rollout and rollback to pinned tag. rollback playbook: infra-runbooks/rollback.md
maria: action items list:
- maria: land shim PR (4740) + cut 2.4
- alex: add tf-schema-check CI + codemod prototype
- kevin: coordinate dev-reserved canary and monitor
- sam: write upgrade notes and grep for kms/iam patterns
reconvene after canary. :thumbsup:
maria: I'll post canary status here at 09:30 UTC. ping if you want to watch the apply.
alex: will join for dashboards and apply watch.
maria: linking shim PR: https://git.internal/pr/4740
